title: Spend Firewall policy file (spendfirewall.yaml)
description: Budgets and settings applied with `PUT /v1/admin/policies`. Budgets are matched by name: new names are created, existing ones updated, and enabled budgets missing from the file are disabled.

fail_mode.description: closed: block calls if the firewall's Redis is down (no overspend). open: allow them unenforced (no downtime).

loop_max_repeats.description: Block a session after this many identical calls in the window. 0 disables loop detection.

require_identity.description: Reject calls without X-Agent-Id and X-Session-Id headers.

name.description: Unique name; used to match budgets between syncs.

scope.description: What the budget is counted per. tenant = the whole account.

scope_id.description: Apply only to this one agent/session/customer id. Omit to give every id its own budget.

window.description: Time window the limit resets on. total = never resets (30-day retention).

limit_usd.description: Maximum spend in USD per window.
